Hero.title: Get the <highlight>best rate</highlight> for your loan.
Hero.subtitle: Kredix compares 40 banks and negotiates the most advantageous offer for your profile. Simulate for free, no commitment, and get an answer within 24 hours.

HowItWorks.title: Three steps, zero hassle
HowItWorks.lead: A simple, transparent journey from simulation to signature.
HowItWorks.step1Text: Estimate your monthly payment in seconds with our simulator, then submit your application online.
HowItWorks.step2Text: Your broker analyses your profile and consults our 40 partner banks to negotiate the best rate.
HowItWorks.step3Text: You receive your offer within 24 hours. We support you all the way to signature, with no upfront fees.

Simulator.title: Estimate your monthly payment
Simulator.lead: Adjust the amount and duration. Your estimate updates live.
Simulator.note: Indicative estimate excluding insurance and fees. The final rate depends on your profile and the lender. This simulation is not a loan offer.

Services.title: Support for every project

Services.card1Text: Purchase, construction or rental investment: we negotiate the best rate to make your property project happen.
Services.card2Text: Renovations, car, personal project: get fast financing at the most competitive conditions.
Services.card3Text: Combine your loans into one reduced monthly payment and bring calm back to your budget.
Services.card4Text: Grow your business with financing designed for entrepreneurs, freelancers and companies.

Engagements.title: Our Commitments
Engagements.lead: Since 2015, we have guided our clients through every type of loan — transparent, fast, and always in your best interest.

Engagements.item2Desc: Your request is handled within 24 hours by a certified advisor.
Engagements.item3Desc: We compare over 40 partner banks to secure the most favorable rate for you.
Engagements.item4Desc: 94% of our applications are approved by the banks.
Engagements.item5Desc: A dedicated advisor guides you from first contact to loan payout.
